item_title: Blackstone to acquire a 52% stake in R Systems, a publicly traded Indian IT services company, for $359M
item_description: Reuters: Blackstone to acquire a 52% stake in R Systems, a publicly traded Indian IT services company, for $359M — U.S. investment fund Blackstone Inc (BX.N) said on Thursday it would buy a 52% stake in India's R Systems International (RSYS.NS) from the IT services company's promoters for $359 million.
